d: Kim talks about being on Dancing with the Stars in 2008, a book coming out about her called Citizen Kim, visiting the Great Wall of China, going to different McDonald’s around the world, her wellness routine, season two of “All’s Fair” on Hulu, support from her co-stars, reading reviews from critics, her journey to becoming a lawyer, becoming interested in law when her father Robert Kardashian represented OJ Simpson, and going through OJ’s luggage when he stayed at their house.
